$comment: Single source of truth for level backdrop art. Read by the app (rendering) and by scripts/gen-level-art.mjs (AI generation). Add a level by appending an entry here, then run the preview harness.
style: 16-bit pixel art, crisp clean pixels, cohesive night palette deep blue violet with warm orange window light and magenta cyan neon accents, dithering, retro snes game art, no text, no watermark, no people

prompts.sky: parisian night sky with stars and distant haussmann rooftops silhouette, full moon haze
prompts.facade: long parisian haussmann stone apartment facade at night, front elevation, many tall windows some glowing warm orange others dark with shutters, ornate wrought iron balconies, zinc roof, ground floor shops with neon signs
prompts.street: parisian night sidewalk and cobblestone street, wet asphalt reflections, neon glow, gutter, street level horizontal strip
